paite: Ka tung gik hina mai e! Nipithei sekkhawm hun lai a om bang leh grep loh hun lai a grep maih loh ding bang ka hi ngal a; gahbom nek ding a-om kei; ka hinna in theipi min masa alunggulh hi.
heading: Gamtat Hoih lam A Israel Siatna
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

paite: Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan amang ua, mihing lak ah midiktak a-om kei uh; sisan suah ding in atang vek ua; michih in amau unau len in agem uhi.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

paite: Akhutte uh thil hoih lou tung a thanuamtak a hih ding in anga ua; kumpipa'n thilpiak angiat a, vaihawmpa'n anegu a; milian in alungsim thilhihkhelhna agenkhia a; huai in akithutuak uhi.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

paite: Alak ua mihoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; midikpen leng dailing nei sang in ahoih kei zaw; nang veng mite ni, veh a na om ni ngei ahong tung hi; huai tuh amangbat ni uh ahi ding hi.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

paite: Lawm ah muang kei unla, makaimi ah ginna koih kei un; na angsung a omnu a kipan in na kam kongkhakte veng in.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

paite: Tapa in pa min ahihsia a, tanu in anu adou a, mou in api adou ngal a; mihing melmate zaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n zaw TOUPA lam ka en ding a; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathian in ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

paite: Aw ka melma, ka puk hun chiang in hon awi ke'n; ka thounawn ding; mial a ka tut in leng TOUPA kei a ding in vak ahi ding hi.
heading: Israel In Pathian Aginna
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

paite: TOUPA tung a thil ka hihkhelh ziak in, alung hihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tungthu ahon genpih a, kei a dia vaihawmna atangtun masiah; vak ah ahon pikhe ding a, huan diktatna ka mu ding hi.
english: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

paite: Huchi in ka melma ka kiang a, TOUPA na Pathian koi ah, chipa'n huai amu ding a, zahlakna'n amah atuam ding hi. Ka mite'n amah a-en ding ua; tu'n zaw kongzing buannawi bang a sikden ahita ding hi.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Na kulhbaangte bawlna ni ding leh na gamgi kekletna ni ahong tung ding hi.
heading: Tunding Nawnna Thupuan
english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi a kipan, Aigupta leh Lui pha hial a kipan, tuipi leh tuipi kikal a kipan leh tang leh tang kikal a kipan na kiang ah ahong pai ding uhi.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

paite: Huchipi in gam, asung a tengte ziak leh athilhih uh gah ziak in hihgam ahi ding hi.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

paite: Karmel tangkal a gamnuai a lungzuangtak a om na goutan belamhon, na mite na khetbuk zang in vak inla; nidanglai bang in Bashan leh Gilead ah vak in om chiat uhen.
heading: Israel Tung A TOUPA Lainatna
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan a na paikhiak lai bang in akiang ah thillamdang mahmahte ka ensak ding hi.
english: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

paite: Namte'n huai amu ding ua, athilhihtheihna tengteng uh azumpih ding uh; amuk uh ahum ding ua, abil uh angong ding hi.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

paite: Gul bang in leivui aliak ding ua; bokkhup a vakte bang in a-omna kua ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong pai ding uh; TOUPA i Pathian kiang ah laudan siam kawm in ahong pai ding ua, nang ziak in alau ding uhi.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

paite: Nang bang a thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh agoutan khosuaksun tatlekna nelhsiah Pathian kua a-om a? Ahehna tangtawn in avom gige kei; zahngaihna a akipah mahmah ziak in.
heading: Pathian Chitna Kimpih Nei Lou
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

paite: Akiheikik nawn ding a, i tung ah hehpihna anei ding; akhenuai ah i thulimlouhnate asikden ding a; nang amaute khelhna tengteng tuipi taw thukpi ah na pailut ding hi.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

paite: Nidanglai a ka pu leh pate kiang a na kichiamsa, Jakob kiang ah thutak leh Abraham kiang ah zahngaihna na tangtun ding hi.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
